recent_calls.summary: Katherine called to report an emergency air conditioning issue after a storm caused a power outage, leaving her 92-year-old mother in intolerable heat. The agent documented the emergency, prioritized the case, and informed Katherine that a technician would contact her on the next business day. The call ended with the user satisfied and no further requests.
The user, Pamela Bird, called to report a sewer main backup issue. The agent began assessing the urgency of the situation but the call ended abruptly before completion.

Erin from American Home Shield called Budget's after-hours assistant, Evie, to provide a dispatch number and customer details for Michael Whittaker. Erin requested confirmation on whether any service was performed at the property, as the customer wanted to cancel the service and ensure no charges were applied. Evie documented the request and informed Erin that the team would follow up on the next business day.

The user, Scott, reported that his AC unit in the back is tripping a breaker and shutting off. The agent, Evie, informed him that since it is after-hours, a live person is not available but assured that a representative will call him back on the next business day. The user confirmed his phone number and declined further assistance.
The call was very brief with only the agent greeting the user and no further interaction before the user hung up.

The agent collected all necessary details including contact information and service address, and confirmed the request would be followed up on the next business day. The call concluded with the user satisfied and no special instructions for the technician.
